title: Reference Laboratory Operations: Batch Stage of a Specimen at Cancellation
content:
Reference testing on Laboratory Test Orders accessions of the Esoteric Reference Testing class runs in batches. How far a specimen is from its batch when the accession is cancelled sets a batch multiplier on the starting amount of the reference-testing cancellation handling fee.

**Clause.** When the accession is *accessioned* and its specimen has been in house fewer than **2** calendar days since its received date, the starting amount is multiplied by **0.5**, because the specimen has not yet been aliquoted for its reference batch. When the accession is *accessioned* and its specimen has been in house 2 calendar days or more, the starting amount is multiplied by **0.8**. An accession on *testing hold* keeps the starting amount unmultiplied.

| Status | Calendar days since the received date | Batch multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| Accessioned | 0 or 1 | 0.5 |
| Accessioned | 2 or more | 0.8 |
| Testing hold | any | unmultiplied |

**Boundary (hypothetical dates).** A specimen received on 4 August and still accessioned: on 5 August (1 day) the multiplier is 0.5; on 6 August (2 days) it is 0.8.
